line_items.reasoning: Q2 revenue came in at approximately $5.835B (Data Center $2.8B + Client $1.5B + Gaming $648M + Embedded $861M), above the guided midpoint of $5.7B and near the top of the $5.4B–$6.0B range; additionally, the full-year Data Center GPU outlook was raised to >$4.5B, surpassing the prior >$4.0B guide.

Data Center hit a record $2.8B with MI300 GPU quarterly revenue exceeding $1B for the first time, clearly exceeding the guided 'double-digit percentage sequential growth' and prompting a further raise to the full-year GPU revenue outlook.
Client revenue grew 49% YoY to $1.5B and swung to $89M operating income, well above the guidance of modest sequential growth and a return to profitability.
Non-GAAP gross margin came in at exactly 53%, matching the guided ~53% target, though MI300 margins remain below corporate average, limiting further upside.
Gaming declined ~30% QoQ, which is consistent with the guided 'significant double-digit percentage' sequential decline, and H2 is still expected to be lower than H1, in line with prior guidance.

Embedded revenue fell 41% YoY to $861M and recovery was described as only 'gradual' with single-digit sequential growth in Q3, falling short of the guided flat sequential performance and a more meaningful H2 recovery.
